answer.summary: Establish a transparent, repeatable experimental framework for evaluating agent memory under fixed token budgets using a shared benchmark with explicit documentation of missing baselines and performance gaps.
answer.content: Propose a new research question focused on designing a transparent, repeatable experiment to evaluate agent memory systems on a single shared benchmark under fixed token constraints, emphasizing clear documentation of missing baselines and performance gaps where controlled comparisons do not exist. This addresses the critical gap in current literature for reproducible, observable evaluations of memory effectiveness without relying on uncontrolled or indirect metrics.
answer.search: find peer-reviewed experiments from 2022 to 2024 that describe transparent, repeatable evaluations of agent memory on a shared benchmark (e.g., BigBench) under fixed token budgets, with explicit documentation of missing baselines or performance gaps
answer.nextTask: Design and inspect one source that details a transparent, repeatable experiment evaluating agent memory on BigBench under fixed token budgets, with explicit notes on missing baselines or performance gaps. Limit to one source; do not implement code or systems.
answer.lesson: Prioritize transparent, repeatable experiments with explicit baseline documentation when evaluating agent memory to establish scientific validity and avoid reliance on uncontrolled or indirect evidence.
